label: bcsF
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the bcsF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor bcsF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 176 to 255 from dnaA. Read in 518 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying bcsF once); 41,440 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.27 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 29,714 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; shell 11,552 calls, named 85%, 0.58 bits; cloud 174 calls, named 8%, 2.03 bits. Outside an RGP 30,947 calls, named 93%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 10,493 calls, named 89%, 0.51 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 30 fork, 8 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.51 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (89% against 93%); 10,493 of the 41,440 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 (bcsE, a fork column) 0.87 bits, RGP 99%; column 3 (bcsQ, a variable column) 0.75 bits, RGP 97%; column 4 (bcsA, a variable column) 0.66 bits, RGP 96%. The 12 columns (columns 0-7 and 34-37) where most calls are in an RGP: named 94%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 68 columns: named 92%, 0.25 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 42 spine columns: named 93%, 0.21 bits on average; the 38 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.33 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 1, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 1 (fork), RGP 99%; the least: columns 5-32 (spine), RGP 0-93%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
